description_en: Exposes instance topology information and download links for commercial backup sets to support offline restoration of cloud instances
description_zh: 开放商业备份集的实例拓扑信息和下载链接，满足线下恢复云上实例的需要
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx describe-open-backup-set --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name pxc-00000000 --restore-time 2024-10-14T00:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeOpenBackupSet

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The point in time to which you want to restore the instance. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
parameters.help_zh: 实例所需恢复的时间点，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: restore_time
